notes.title: Shivers, swag, shenanigans
notes.content:
Your quick peek at some the Halloween events in upjers games

The night of Halloween is looming ahead. This means it‘s party-time for upjers!

We want to give you an overview on the Halloween-Events starting across many games next 
week. Here‘s what you can expect:​

My Little Farmies

https://store.steampowered.com/app/789100/My_Little_Farmies/

From October 22nd to 29th the Halloween-themed collector-event is waiting for you. Decorate your village with eeriely-cute Voodoo decorations to collect all the Shrunken head-tokens to win valuable prizes like the new „Saddler‘s“ production facility. There you can craft saddles and other products.

My Free Zoo

https://store.steampowered.com/app/694130/My_Free_Zoo/

Is this too morbid for you? Then you may already be looking forward to collect Lionhead tokens at My Free Zoo. Put up scary-looking glow-in-the-dark animal statues to have the chance to win the adorable and very exclusive Siberian musk deer to exhibit in your zoo. (The events runs 
between October 23rd and 30th.)

My Free Farm

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049880/My_Free_Farm/

This year the My Free Farm Halloween-Event is challenging your gray matter again! The Halloween card-matching game is back! When you mange to clear all cards from the table within ten tries, you have the chance to win new amusing trophies for your collection. (October 22nd 
through to November 5th.)

But also your  Horse Farm (24 – 30 October), Wauies (24 – 31 October), My Sunny Resort (23 – 30 October) and My Free Farm 2 (29 October – 5 November) are packed full with fun events 
to take the edge off the dark season.

notes.title: Make your friends welcome: the new visitor region in My Little Farmies
notes.content:
Double the friend rewards, gold boosters and more


one of the factors to have a lot of fun in My Little Farmies is to have lots of friends and 
visiting them regularly to help them with their farms.

Lately we added a new region you can use to make your friends much more comfortable; 

The visitor region.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/a16f602b9b1898b074f53ee0e91cb023231417ff.jpg

Here you can create a smaller version of your farm to welcome your friends. Your benefits:

your friends will arrive on your farm much quicker (shorter loading times), they – as well as 
yourself – will get a full friendship star for helping you out. And also for every 18 stars 
collected, you will get one of seven parts for a gold booster!

Unlocking your visitor region, you need the cartographer and have to do a few small tasks and pay a fee.

Starting at level 15, unlocking the region costs 150 gold bars while at level 40+ you may also pay in Thalers. Your tasks are:

expanding your main farm ten times
have ten friends and
collect 200 friendship stars

The game starts counting from either the moment you unlock the cartographer or, if already unlocked, since the patch went live.

In turn you get a region where you can place fields, decorations and animal pens. Also you can use – except for the special buildings (carriage station, servant‘s and farmhouses, contest tent, market place, stalls, the crier and the tourist info) – all production buildings and workers.

You see: while it‘s quite complex to get, the rewards are more than making it up for you and your 
visitors.

notes.title: World Cup Event
notes.content:
Dear Farmers,

Football fever has gripped the farm! But the Farmies aren't just focusing on goals, balls and the best possible lawn care - they also see it as an opportunity to welcome other cultures into their everyday life and learn more about this year's hosts in theWorld Cup Event!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/159dd719415b9d0d4c396384a16c266e0ec5d4b5.jpg

For the duration of the event, you'll find the seasonal section of your shop stocked with impressive Russian landmarks and international banners - use them to show your enthusiasm for your team and this year's enchanting host country.

Each World Cup decoration you place on your farm will give you points in the form of Footballs at regular intervals. Just click on the pin that appears above them to collect your Footballs.

One special decoration - the King's Gate - will instantly give you 7,500 Footballs when you charge it for 10 Gold Bars.

You can click on this icon at the right side of your playing field to see your progress. Collecting enough Footballs before the event ends on July 10 at 10:59 am CEST will allow you to earn tons of fertilizer for your farm!

You can also help out your friends by sending pieces of two exclusive World Cup friendship gifts!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/93b6d403453d199c0d629ee99c5b3434382e063a.jpg

25,000 Footballs - 1,000 Vegetable Fertilizer
50,000 Footballs - 5,000 Fruit Fertilizer
100,000 Footballs - 10,000 Fiber Fertilizer
200,000 Footballs - 30,000 Herb Fertilizer
400,000 Footballs - 50,000 Wood Fertilizer
800,000 Footballs - 125,000 Flower Fertilizer

You read right - there are two new types of fertilizer*, which can now be made in your Fertilizer Factory! Flower Fertilizer and Wood Fertilizer! 

Enjoy the game!

Your My Little Farmies Team

* [spoiler]With these, you can accelerate the following flowers and wood:
Marigolds, Oxeye Daisies, Pink Roses, Red Tulips// Maple, Oak and Pine![/spoiler]

notes.title: New Guild Destinations!
notes.content:
Today's patch finally brings you new destinations for your guild expeditions in My Little Farmies!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/e121a22f313322674b8bb7665f6b6de42fadb186.jpg

Effective immediately, there are eight new destinations available. These are much further away than current expeditions, so you'll want to prepare bigger and faster ships for these new voyages.

The coordinates for these trade destinations are a well-kept secret and can be acquired in the guild shop for a price (either Thalers or Gold Bars). The costs are covered by the guild funds - which means only Aldermen and Consuls can make these purchases for the guild.

Once unlocked, the following new destinations can be visited:

Torys
Tamasne
Azbet Nesir
Karemali
Cape Tarney
Bemanda
Kosanga-Landu
Ozambonda
Since the map now encompasses a whole lot of different destinations, we've added a handy compass to navigate between them.

Paired with these new destinations, there are also eight new colonial goods!

Last but not least, you can now fill your marketstalls straight from the warehouse with a convenient button.

Enjoy your explorations!

notes.title: Egg Week!
notes.content:
Easter is almost here! And what would the village children do without a good Easter egg hunt? So of course, eggs are in high demand! Luckily for you, your chickens are up to the challenge!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31996989/7e9213f171fc38ec38766681a3b93702839c3cc5.jpg

From now until Tuesday, April 11, at 11:59am CEST, your chickens will produce eggs twice as fast. But that's not all! Due to the high demand, your customers will also pay double for your eggs!

We've also added 10 new warehouse expansions available at level 40 and up - these add 200 to your warehouse capacity and cost 150 Gold Bars each (upgrades 55, 58 and 61 can also be purchased with Thalers).

Last but not least:

Valentine's decorations have been removed from the Gem Shop and replaced with Easter decorations.
NPCs, animals and wonders of the world in the Gem Shop now have dynamic price scaling and will become increasingly expensive the more of the same ones you buy.
When placing newly bought animals, you'll now find a "jump to next suitable enclosure" button on the card in the card bar.
